title.narrative: UNRCO - Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework - One UN Fund

description.narrative:
UNRCO - Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework - One UN Fund The principle aim of the Multi-Partner Trust Fund is to contribute to the five-year United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework 2022-2027 (UNSDCF) overall impact on the reduction of multidimensional poverty in Tanzania through a transformative inclusive, sustainable economic transformation and growth. Central to the framework as a whole is enabling the UN Country-Team to act and deliver as one in Tanzania, delivering on UN reform at the country-level and enhancing inter-agency cooperation.
The UNSDCF covers all 17 SDG's, although only 10 can be listed in PTA. The 10 selected are representative for the aims of the UNSDCF.
